Rear and front legs alternate, feet lift/plant and pass, knees and hips move together, torso counter-rotates subtly, both hands maintain boxing guard. It must visibly walk through eight DISTINCT contact/down/passing/up phases, not repeat the same idle or punching pose. Stable identity and scale, smooth last-to-first loop. Root at x43.75% of cell and floor at y93.75%. Use source pose guide's 270px equivalent adult body height within each 320px cell; no individual pose scaling.
